Weekly health insurance claim turnaround times and settlement amounts across regional operations centers in 2023.

The Quality Assurance and Claims Operations Department at Apex Health Insurance compiled weekly sampled records of closed claims throughout 2023 to evaluate operational turnaround benchmarks, identify processing bottlenecks across regional centers, and monitor adjudication speed across claim types.

## Columns

| Column | Kind | Declared as |
|---|---|---|
| `adjudicated_amount` | measure | unit USD; additive |
| `center_region` | category | Northeast, Midwest, South, West; group organization |
| `claim_type` | category | Inpatient, Outpatient, Pharmacy, Dental; group claim_attributes |
| `claimed_amount` | measure | unit USD; additive |
| `cycle_time_days` | measure | unit days; additive |
| `month` | category | 2022-12, 2023-01, 2023-02, 2023-03, 2023-04, 2023-05, 2023-06, 2023-07, 2023-08, 2023-09, 2023-10, 2023-11, and 1 more; ordered=ordinal; derived from settlement_week; group calendar |
| `processing_center` | category | Boston Hub, Chicago Hub, Atlanta Hub, Phoenix Hub; within center_region; group organization |
| `quarter` | category | 2022-Q4, 2023-Q1, 2023-Q2, 2023-Q3, 2023-Q4; ordered=ordinal; derived from settlement_week; group calendar |
| `settlement_week` | time | 2023-01-01 to 2023-12-31, weekly; group calendar |
| `submission_channel` | category | Electronic EDI, Provider Portal, Paper Mail; group intake |
